recipe.visualDefinition: A collection of six distinct, illustrated masks arranged in a 2x3 grid on a textured off-white background, topped by a metallic, beveled logo plaque. The masks range from realistic human features to stylized animals and mechanical/fantasy creatures, all rendered with smooth airbrush gradients and high-contrast lighting.
coreVisualRelationships: Grid-based alignment of disparate mask styles
Central vertical axis for logo and mask spacing
Consistent high-contrast shadows across all illustrated elements
Relationship between organic human eyes and sharp, geometric mask edges
coreInvariants: Metallic, beveled plaque for top-center text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Six masks occupy the central and lower two-thirds of the frame in a balanced 2x3 grid. The logo plaque sits at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The top-center metallic logo plaque acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top logo, move down through the grid of masks, alternating between the left and right columns.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Uniform spacing between masks and a wide margin around the grid creates a clean, catalog-like presentation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream/Off-white background providing a neutral canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the eyes and shadows of the masks.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold and bronze metallic tones in the logo and specific mask details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with saturated earth tones and muted blues/pinks in the masks.

letterConstructionRules: Thick, blocky strokes with sharp serifs
Letters are contained within a curved, bordered plaque
Inner glow and drop shadow for depth
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are slightly arched to follow the plaque's curve
High-shine highlights on the upper edges of glyphs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single consistent style for both lines of text within the plaque.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider lines within the plaque

candidateDirections.reason: Similar slab serif structure and weight

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 2x3 grid of six surreal masks on a textured cream background. Masks should include: a realistic male face, a snarling tiger, a stone-like face with jagged teeth, a realistic female face, a pink mask with green snakes, and a metallic spiked mask. Use 80s airbrush style.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a top-centered metallic gold plaque containing two lines of arched, beveled slab-serif text. The text should have a 3D polished metal effect.

verificationChecks: Is the text contained in a beveled metallic plaque?
Does the illustration style look like 80s airbrushing?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the masks
Unique snake arrangement on the bottom-left mask

mustAchieve: High-quality metallic rendering for the logo

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is beveled and metallic
Ensure no photographic elements are used
recipe.reuseFormula: Create a 2x3 grid of [Subject: Masks/Icons] in an [Style: 80s Airbrush] aesthetic on a [Background: Textured Cream] surface, topped with a [Graphic: Metallic Beveled Plaque] containing [Typography: Arched Slab Serif] text.
